name: hromada-aid
description: Клієнт-серверна система обліку матеріальних допомог громади

scripts.manager:build: node scripts/clean-server-manager-main.mjs && tsc -p server-manager/tsconfig.json && tsc -p server-manager/tsconfig.electron.json && vite build --config server-manager/vite.config.ts
scripts.manager:portable: pnpm windows:package && pnpm manager:build && node scripts/package-server-manager.mjs
scripts.manager:test: pnpm manager:build && node --test server-manager/tests/shell.test.mjs server-manager/tests/inspection.test.mjs server-manager/tests/inspection-presentation.test.mjs server-manager/tests/installation-engine.test.mjs server-manager/tests/installation-recovery.test.mjs server-manager/tests/service-control.test.mjs server-manager/tests/manager-icon.test.mjs server-manager/tests/server-update.test.mjs server-manager/tests/server-update-legacy.integration.test.mjs && node scripts/server-manager.mjs smoke && node scripts/server-manager.mjs smoke-dev && node scripts/server-manager.mjs smoke-status
scripts.build: tsc -b && node scripts/clean-electron-build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node electron/copy-assets.mjs && vite build
scripts.server:dev: pnpm server:build && concurrently -k "pnpm exec tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --watch" "node --watch dist-server/server/src/index.js"
scripts.windows:test-installer: pnpm server:build && node --test dist-server/server/src/create-admin.test.js packaging/windows-branding.test.mjs packaging/component-package.test.mjs packaging/verify-server-package.test.mjs packaging/server-package-transaction.test.mjs scripts/deploy-server-package.test.mjs scripts/windows-installer-space.test.mjs scripts/windows-installer-paths.test.mjs
scripts.windows:package: pnpm build && pnpm server:build && node scripts/prepare-server-package.mjs && node scripts/deploy-server-package.mjs && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win --x64 --dir && node scripts/package-windows.mjs
scripts.client:portable: pnpm build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win --x64 --dir && node scripts/package-client-portable.mjs
scripts.windows:installer: pnpm run windows:package && pnpm run manager:build && node scripts/package-server-manager.mjs && node scripts/build-windows-installer.mjs
scripts.manager:test-stage7: pnpm manager:build && node --test server-manager/tests/shell.test.mjs server-manager/tests/inspection.test.mjs server-manager/tests/inspection-presentation.test.mjs server-manager/tests/service-control.test.mjs server-manager/tests/manager-icon.test.mjs && node scripts/server-manager.mjs smoke && node scripts/server-manager.mjs smoke-dev && node scripts/server-manager.mjs smoke-status
